changelog:
- Initial release of the self-awareness framework for OpenClaw agents.
- Imprints reliable knowledge of the agent’s runtime, storage, memory, and failure handling protocols.
- Introduces always-active operating rules to prevent guessing, context drift, and lateral-move debugging.
- Adds a /selfcheck protocol with checklist and reporting standards.
- Sets up a weekly self-audit via cron job and establishes a drift log for detected issues.
- Includes references to core documentation for accurate, transparent agent operation.
